function: Learns UAV velocity and the ISAC transmit beamformer and power ratio, maximizing offloaded computation under sensing and URLLC constraints; computing allocation is convex, not learned (pp. 8-9).
system: NOMA-aided UAV ISCC: UAV with 12-antenna vertical ULA at 100 m, single-antenna users and fog node, 1 MHz bandwidth, carrier frequency not stated; no RIS (pp. 4, 11).
method: Soft actor-critic DRL (SAC-TPBD): policy network and twin Q networks, off-policy training with experience replay; reward mixes offloading throughput, URLLC deficit terms and a sensing-SNR penalty (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator, 400 m x 400 m area: probabilistic air-ground LoS/NLoS channel with distance path loss (LoS probability 1); Rician fading in an extension (pp. 4, 11, 15).
test_conditions: Same simulated environment for training and evaluation; sweeps of sensing threshold, power budget, antennas, users, flight period and CSI error; no cross-scenario test stated (pp. 11-14).
baselines: Non-learned: fly-and-hover with SDR, TPBD of [18] with SCA and SDR, fog-only, OMA, SDMA. Learned: DDPG, TD3, PPO, compared only on reward curves (pp. 11, 13).
metrics: Computed task amount (bit), task queue and virtual-queue backlogs (URLLC), beampattern gain, accumulated reward, implementation time (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Orders stated: implementation O(T|s||a|) against O(Imax((TN^2)^3.5+(2T)^3.5)) for [18]; training order given; decision time about 5e-3 s (pp. 10-11, 13).
q1_support: p. 4: "leverage the probabilistic channel model" for the ground-to-UAV link, with its own distance path-loss law (exponent 2, p. 11); no 3GPP TR 38.811 or 38.901, DeepMIMO or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 14: "the imperfect CSI is invoked to train the proposed SAC-TPBD" (a CSI-error sweep); not met because training and testing share one environment, the state size 6MK+2M+2N+4 (p. 8) fixes users and antennas, and the Rician extension (p. 15) does not say a trained agent is reused.
q3_support: p. 11: "Baseline DRL Method [41]" (DDPG, TD3, PPO) is compared only on learning curves, "converges more rapidly" (p. 13), not on task amount or beampattern; the non-learned TPBD and fly-and-hover comparisons are on computed task amount.
q4_support: p. 10: "The computational complexity of Algorithm 1 is analyzed below." with training and implementation orders on pp. 10-11, and a measured decision time of about 5e-3 s on p. 13.
q5_support: p. 11: "Table I lists the remaining" parameters and SAC hyperparameters; the data come from the authors' own simulated environment and no code or data link is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: The first page of the PDF holds the title URLLC-Aware Trajectory Plan and Beamforming Design for NOMA-Aided UAV Integrated Sensing, Communication, and Computation Networks and DOI 10.1109/TVT.2024.3460813. It passes above_phy because the SAC agent learns the beamformer and power ratio jointly with the UAV trajectory (p. 8). Area 6 over 5 by the specificity order: aerial link with an ISAC beam. q3 is 0 because DDPG, TD3 and PPO appear only in the convergence comparison of Fig. 8(a) (p. 13), so the reviewer may confirm. Fig. 13 (p. 15) reruns the method under Rician fading without saying a trained agent is reused.
